recipes.title: Chat with PDF documents offline
recipes.description: Prepare models before disconnecting, choose local processing at every stage, and inspect cited passages. These documented configurations have not been installed or quality-benchmarked in this research pass.

picks.label: Folder-based document collections
picks.reason: LocalDocs indexes local text snippets and exposes source references.
picks.tradeoff: Disable off-device embedding, use a local chat model and note the unverified maintenance status.

picks.label: Attach documents to a local chat
picks.reason: Supports PDF attachments with local processing and a documented offline workflow.
picks.tradeoff: Long files use retrieval; cloud features and model downloads are separate online operations.

picks.label: Configurable document workspaces
picks.reason: Combines PDF ingestion with selectable local models, embeddings and storage.
picks.tradeoff: All selected providers must stay local; first-use model downloads and context limits need preparation.

recipes.title: Reduce steady noise in an audio recording
recipes.description: Compare two documented noise-profile workflows for recorded material. Judge artifacts against the original recording; these entries do not establish live microphone suppression or a measured quality winner.

picks.label: Focused free editing workflow
picks.reason: Provides a noise-profile effect for steady hum, hiss and similar backgrounds.
picks.tradeoff: Needs a noise-only sample and is unsuitable for many irregular noises.

picks.label: Inside an existing multitrack project
picks.reason: The included ReaFIR effect offers profile-based subtraction.
picks.tradeoff: Paid workstation licensing and effect setup are additional considerations.
